# AI Slop Detector

Write without AI slop, or check a draft for it: a list of 120 patterns in 9 categories (Vocabulary, Stock phrases, Sentence patterns, Structure and rhythm, Imagery and metaphor, Substance, Formatting and punctuation, Chatbot residue, Social media and LinkedIn) to avoid when writing or editing posts, emails, articles, scripts or docs, and to report by ID, name, exact quoted text and a short fix when checking a draft — with no score and no guess about whether AI wrote it.
